"""Publication-check erratum: compare counters in their JSON representation."""
import base64
import gzip
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('etw_publication_r1',HERE/'publish.py')
p=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(p)


def check():
    data,analyses,proof=p.validate();public=p.load(p.PUBLIC)
    # JSON object keys are always strings, including the packet-type counters.
    canonical=json.loads(json.dumps(analyses,ensure_ascii=False))
    assert public['experiment']==data and public['analyses']==canonical and public['validation']==proof
    assert public['raw_audit']==p.load(HERE/'raw-audit-r1.json') and public['archive_sha256']==p.b.sha(p.ARCHIVE)
    for item in json.loads(gzip.decompress(p.ARCHIVE.read_bytes()))['files']:
        contents=base64.b64decode(item['content_base64'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest()==item['sha256'] and (p.ROOT/item['path']).read_bytes()==contents
    assert json.loads(json.dumps({0:240}))=={'0':240}
    p.a.selfcheck()
    print('PASS JSON-normalized counters,exact archived events,protocols and independent interval/pairing analysis',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    with p.b.gpu_lock():check()

"""Add an immutable correction; never rewrite the original ETW publication."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('etw_corrected_check',HERE/'check.py')
c=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(c)
p=c.p
OUT=p.ROOT/'sycl/orca/direct-etw-scheduler-check-a770-windows-2026-11-08.json'
REPORT=p.ROOT/'bench/results/a770/orca-direct-etw-scheduler-check-2026-11-08.md'

with p.b.gpu_lock():
    assert not OUT.exists() and not REPORT.exists()
    c.check()
    manifest=dict(complete=True,stage='offline checker correction;zero additional GPU requests',
        preserved_failure='Original post-export check compared integer packet-type keys against JSON string keys and raised AssertionError. Original report,JSON,archive,source and all measurements remain unchanged.',
        correction='Normalize the independently recalculated analyses through JSON before equality comparison;all exact source/protocol/archive checks retained.',
        parent={x.relative_to(p.ROOT).as_posix():p.b.sha(x) for x in (p.PUBLIC,p.ARCHIVE,p.REPORT)},
        sources=[dict(path=x.relative_to(p.ROOT).as_posix(),sha256=p.b.sha(x),text=x.read_text('utf8')) for x in (HERE/'check.py',Path(__file__))],
        check_passed=True,performance_claim=False,production_changed=False,linux_gpu_tested=False)
    p.b.save(OUT,manifest)
    REPORT.write_text('# GPU调度追踪：离线复核命令勘误\n\n'
        '原报告归档已经完整生成，但末尾复核把Python的整数packet-type键与JSON读取后的字符串键直接比较，触发AssertionError。修正复核器先统一JSON表示；完整原始协议、独立区间／配对复算、源码和归档逐字节检查全部通过。原报告、JSON、归档、源码及所有GPU样本保留，没有新增GPU请求。\n\n'
        '正确离线命令：`python -X utf8 build-orca-etw-scheduler-20261108/check.py`。原报告所列`publish.py check`保留为失败记录。\n\n'
        '[原调度报告](orca-direct-etw-scheduler-2026-11-08.md) · '
        '[勘误、原文件摘要与精确复核源码](../../../sycl/orca/'+OUT.name+')\n',encoding='utf8')
    print('PASS immutable checker correction;original publication preserved',flush=True)
